tags.description: The Lake Merritt Channel is not artificial, but part of the tidal slough that is Lake Merritt. Parts of the channel have been put underground, but since 2012, the channel has been returned to a more natural state. There are flood control gates at East 8th

tags.description: Pleasant Valley Creek originates in Dracena Park in Piedmont and flows under Grand Avenue to the northern outfall at Lake Merritt. It is entirely culverted except for its headwaters north of the park’s entrance.
